title: 0 · Pipeline Overview - SDI Data Mart
description: One-screen health summary of the SDI pipeline, organised around five management questions.

options.content:
Pharma Cold-Chain DWH · Pipeline Overview
Sales & Demand Intelligence mart: Airflow → batch + stream ingestion → bronze → validated silver → gold star schema → optimized queries
① How much data? ② How efficient? ③ Which sources perform well? ④ What is happening in the warehouses? ⑤ Where are the problems?

panels.title: Last completed refresh
panels.description: Most recent refresh that finished end-to-end

targets.rawSql: SELECT refresh_id || '  ·  ' || COALESCE(refresh_month, '') || '  ·  ' || to_char(finished_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS label FROM ops.refresh_log WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: ⬆ Rows ingested (bronze)
panels.description: All rows landed from the 7 source files, history + refreshes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(row_count) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (schema_name, table_name) * FROM ops.storage_snapshot
             ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, captured_at DESC) s WHERE layer = 'bronze'

SELECT sum(row_count) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (schema_name, table_name) * FROM ops.storage_snapshot
             ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, captured_at DESC) s WHERE layer = 'gold' AND table_name LIKE 'fact%'
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS','SKIPPED_DUPLICATE')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'RUNNING'),0) FROM ops.batch_load_log

panels.title: ⚠ Rows quarantined
panels.description: Rows rejected by data-quality rules (kept for audit)

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at) FROM ops.refresh_log WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT avg(server_ms) FROM ops.query_log WHERE variant = 'optimized'

panels.title: ① How much data, and where does it live?   ② How efficiently does each refresh run?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE layer WHEN 'bronze' THEN '1 Bronze (raw)' WHEN 'silver' THEN '2 Silver (ODS)'
                  WHEN 'gold' THEN '3 Gold (star)' WHEN 'mart' THEN '4 Mart (MVs)'
                  ELSE '5 Quarantine' END AS layer, sum(row_count) AS rows
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (schema_name, table_name) * FROM ops.storage_snapshot
             ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, captured_at DESC) s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT refresh_id AS "Refresh", refresh_month AS "Data month", to_char(started_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS "Started",
       round(extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)::numeric, 0) AS "Duration (s)", status AS "Status"
FROM ops.refresh_log ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Data-quality pass rate
panels.description: Share of landed rows that passed every validation rule

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 - 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM quarantine.rejected_rows) / NULLIF((SELECT sum(rows_loaded) FROM ops.batch_load_log WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'),0)

panels.title: ③ Which source domains perform well or poorly?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.source_domain AS "Source domain", sum(b.rows_loaded) AS "Rows loaded", round(sum(b.duration_s), 1) AS "Load time (s)",
       round(sum(b.rows_loaded) / NULLIF(sum(b.duration_s), 0)) AS "Rows / s", COALESCE(sum(b.rows_malformed), 0) AS "Malformed lines",
       COALESCE(q.rejected, 0) AS "Rejected rows",
       round(100.0 * COALESCE(q.rejected, 0) / NULLIF(sum(b.rows_loaded), 0), 2) AS "Reject %"
FROM ops.batch_load_log b
LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_domain, count(*) AS rejected FROM quarantine.rejected_rows GROUP BY 1) q USING (source_domain)
WHERE b.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY b.source_domain, q.rejected ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: ④ What is happening in the warehouses?
Stock on hand by warehouse (latest snapshot, packs)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name AS warehouse, sum(f.closing_qty) AS stock_on_hand
FROM dwh.fact_inventory_snapshot f JOIN dwh.dim_warehouse w USING (warehouse_key)
WHERE f.snapshot_date_key = (SELECT max(snapshot_date_key) FROM dwh.fact_inventory_snapshot)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Warehouse operations matrix
panels.description: Teal = volume (darker = more); amber = risk (darker = more stockouts / near-expiry / expired)

targets.rawSql:
WITH inv AS (
    SELECT f.warehouse_key, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, round(avg(f.available_qty)) AS avg_available,
           sum(f.stockout_flag) AS stockout_lot_days, sum(f.near_expiry_flag) AS near_expiry_lot_days,
           round(100 * avg(f.fefo_compliance_flag), 1) AS fefo_pct, sum(f.expired_qty) AS expired_packs
    FROM dwh.fact_inventory_snapshot f GROUP BY 1
), cur AS (
    SELECT warehouse_key, sum(closing_qty) AS stock_on_hand FROM dwh.fact_inventory_snapshot
    WHERE snapshot_date_key = (SELECT max(snapshot_date_key) FROM dwh.fact_inventory_snapshot) GROUP BY 1
), sal AS (
    SELECT warehouse_key, sum(quantity_sold_packs) AS units_sold FROM dwh.fact_pharmacy_sales GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT w.warehouse_name AS "Warehouse", w.region AS "Region",
       CASE WHEN w.cold_chain_capable THEN '❄ 2-8 °C' ELSE 'Ambient' END AS "Storage",
       cur.stock_on_hand AS "Stock on hand (packs)", inv.avg_available AS "Avg available / lot",
       sal.units_sold AS "Units sold from DC", inv.snapshot_rows AS "Snapshot rows",
       inv.stockout_lot_days AS "Stockout lot-days", inv.near_expiry_lot_days AS "Near-expiry lot-days",
       inv.expired_packs AS "Expired packs", inv.fefo_pct AS "FEFO compliance %"
FROM dwh.dim_warehouse w JOIN inv USING (warehouse_key) LEFT JOIN cur USING (warehouse_key) LEFT JOIN sal USING (warehouse_key)
WHERE w.warehouse_key > 0 ORDER BY "Stock on hand (packs)" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: ⑤ Where are the operational problems?
Top data-quality issues (rows failing each rule)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source_domain || ' · ' || replace(rule_name, '_', ' ') AS rule, sum(failed_rows) AS rows
FROM ops.dq_results WHERE failed_rows > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN reason LIKE 'missing_field:%' THEN 'Missing field: ' || split_part(reason, ':', 2)
            WHEN reason LIKE 'null_key:%' THEN 'Empty key: ' || split_part(reason, ':', 2)
            ELSE 'Invalid / truncated JSON' END AS reason, count(*) AS events
FROM ops.stream_dead_letter GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') / NULLIF(count(*),0) FROM ops.query_log
